这是生成图像网格的模板工作流程。它被设计为供您自行调整，并且用途非常广泛：

  • 任何地方的任何参数都可以按照任何规则从图像到图像进行更改

  • 您可以在不同的提示/模型/设置/图像之间切换（使用WAS 节点套件)

  • 图像在运行时逐一填充。无需等待整个网格。

  • 所有图像都可以保存在子文件夹中

  • 任何地方的任何文本标签、任何字体/大小/颜色

  • 使用任何东西作为背景，包括透明度

这些是我已经用它制作的工作流程：

  • 矩形表（附件中的存档）

  • 图像风扇

  • 饼图

  • 六角网格

安装和依赖

  1. 安装自定义脚本自定义节点；

  2. 安装阿洛尔自定义节点；

  3. 安装骑自行车的人自定义节点；

  4. （可选）安装WAS 节点套件自定义节点；

  5. 下载并打开此工作流程。

如何使用

存档中有两个工作流程：网格Any和网格表.

网格Any：易于修改的模板工作流程。单独在每个图像上写入文本标签。

网格表：标准矩形网格，带有标记的列和原始数据。默认情况下，迭代不同的关键字装饰品束洛拉。用途WAS 节点套件.

您可以在示例图像中看到这两种用途。

  1. 寻找绿色节点。这些包含主要参数。

  2. 寻找蓝色节点。这些包含您可能还想更改的参数。

  3. （可选）更改“计算变化”组来处理您的图像填充的规则。

  4. 检查额外选项和自动排队ComfyUI 浮动菜单中的复选框，按排队提示.

它将用图像一张一张地填充您的网格，并在完成后自动停止。请注意自动排队结束后取消选中复选框。

如何修改

整个要点是网格Any工作流程能够轻松地根据您的目的进行修改。想法是您可以更改任何组来进行您自己的网格设计。

网格设置：当前图像编号如何转换为网格中的 X、Y 或其他坐标。

计算变化：每一步参数如何变化。

计算位置：每个图像都放置在网格中。

生成图像：如何在网格中制作每个图像。您可以使用逻辑开关和选择器WAS 节点套件在整个设置之间进行选择。

单独标签：每张图像上都有文字符号。可以放在网格之外，看一下GridTable工作流程。

保存中间结果：创建一个子文件夹并在其中保存所有图像。您可以更改文件名的制作方式，或将其完全删除。

背景：网格背景已创建。做过一次！您可以动态生成背景图像，但请确保使用固定种子。

将图像添加到网格: ← 不言自明。

o.en:
This is a template workflow to generate grids of images. It's designed to be tuned by youself, and it's very versatile:

  • Any parameters in any place can be changing from image to image, by any rule

  • You can switch between different prompts/models/setups/whatever from image to image (withWAS Node Suite)

  • Images populate runtime, one-by-one. No need to wait for the whole grid.

  • All images can be saved in a subfolder

  • Any text labels, any font/size/color in any place

  • Use anything as a background, including transparency

These are workflows I already made with it:

  • Rectangle Table (in archive attached)

  • Image Fan

  • Pie Diagram

  • Hexagonal Grid

Installation and dependencies

  1. InstallCustom Scriptscustom nodes;

  2. InstallAllorcustom nodes;

  3. InstallCyclistcustom nodes;

  4. (optional) InstallWAS Node Suitecustom nodes;

  5. Download and open this workflow.

How to use

There are two workflows in the archive:GridAnyandGridTable.

GridAny: easy-to-modify template workflow. Writes text labels on every image individually.

GridTable: standard rectangle grid, with labeled columns and raws. By default, iterates through different keywords ofDecorationsBundleLoRA. UsesWAS Node Suite.

You can see both uses in example images.

  1. Look for green nodes. These contains primary parameters.

  2. Look for blue nodes. These contains parameters you may also want to change.

  3. (optional) Change "Calculate Changes" group to handle what rule your images are populated by.

  4. CheckExtra Options andAuto Queuecheckboxes in ComfyUI floating menu, pressQueue Prompt.

It will fill your grid by images one-by-one, and automatically stops when done. Note thatAuto Queuecheckbox unchecks after the end.

How to modify

The whole point of theGridAnyworkflow is being able to easily modify it to your purpose. Idea is that you can change any group to make your own grid design.

Grid Setup: How current image number translates into X, Y or other coordinates in the grid.

Calculate Changes: How parameters change every step.

Calculate Location: Where every image is placed in a grid.

Generate image: How to make every single image in a grid. You can use logic switches and selectors fromWAS Node Suiteto choose between whole setups.

Individual Labels: Text sign on every image. Can be placed outside the grid, look at GridTable workflow.

Save Intermediate Results: Creates a subfolder and saves every image there. You can change how filenames are made, or delete it entirely.

Background: Grid's background created. Made once! You can generate a background image dynamically, but make sure to use fixed seed.

Add Image to Grid: ← self explanatory.
